sql: WITH c AS (SELECT referee, count(*) n FROM sb.matches WHERE referee IS NOT NULL GROUP BY referee) SELECT referee, n AS nb_matchs FROM c WHERE n = (SELECT max(n) FROM c) ORDER BY referee

WITH g AS (
 SELECT e.match_id, e.minute, e.second, e.match_seconds, e.player_id, e.team_id, 'tir' AS nature
 FROM sb.events e JOIN sb.shots s ON s.event_id=e.event_id
 WHERE s.outcome='Goal' AND e.period<>5
 UNION ALL
 SELECT e.match_id, e.minute, e.second, e.match_seconds, e.player_id, e.team_id, 'contre son camp'
 FROM sb.events e WHERE e.type='Own Goal Against')
SELECT p.player_name, t.team_name, g.minute, g.second, g.match_seconds, g.nature, ht.team_name AS equipe_1, at.team_name AS equipe_2, m.stage
FROM g JOIN sb.players p ON p.player_id=g.player_id JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id=g.team_id
JOIN sb.matches m ON m.match_id=g.match_id JOIN sb.teams ht ON ht.team_id=m.home_team_id JOIN sb.teams at ON at.team_id=m.away_team_id
WHERE g.match_seconds = (SELECT min(match_seconds) FROM g)

SELECT count(DISTINCT e.player_id) AS nb_buteurs
FROM sb.shots s
JOIN sb.events e USING (event_id)
WHERE s.outcome = 'Goal'
  AND e.period <> 5

SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) AS matchs, SUM(CASE WHEN m.home_team_id=t.team_id THEN m.home_score ELSE m.away_score END) AS buts_marques FROM sb.matches m JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id IN (m.home_team_id, m.away_team_id) WHERE t.team_name='France' GROUP BY t.team_name

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.type='Shot') AS buts_sur_tir, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.type='Own Goal Against') AS buts_contre_son_camp, count(*) AS total_buts
FROM sb.events e LEFT JOIN sb.shots s ON s.event_id=e.event_id
WHERE e.period=2 AND e.minute>=90 AND ((e.type='Shot' AND s.outcome='Goal') OR e.type='Own Goal Against')

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE carton = 'Yellow Card') AS cartons_jaunes, count(*) FILTER (WHERE carton = 'Second Yellow') AS seconds_jaunes, count(*) AS total_jaunes FROM (SELECT coalesce(details->'foul_committed'->'card'->>'name', details->'bad_behaviour'->'card'->>'name') AS carton FROM sb.events WHERE type IN ('Foul Committed','Bad Behaviour')) c WHERE carton IN ('Yellow Card','Second Yellow')

SELECT t.team_name, count(*) AS centres_tentes, count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.pass_type = 'Corner') AS dont_corners, count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.pass_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'Corner') AS centres_hors_corners, count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.outcome IS NULL) AS centres_reussis
FROM sb.passes p JOIN sb.events e USING (event_id) JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = e.team_id
WHERE t.team_name = 'England' AND p.is_cross AND e.period <> 5
GROUP BY t.team_name

WITH c AS (SELECT t.team_name, count(*) AS nb_corners, count(DISTINCT e.match_id) AS matchs_joues FROM sb.passes p JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = p.event_id JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = e.team_id WHERE p.pass_type = 'Corner' GROUP BY t.team_name) SELECT team_name, nb_corners, matchs_joues FROM c WHERE nb_corners = (SELECT max(nb_corners) FROM c)

SELECT t.team_name, count(*) AS n_possessions, sum(CASE WHEN p.reached_final_third THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_dernier_tiers, avg(CASE WHEN p.reached_final_third THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) AS proportion
FROM sb.possessions p JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = p.team_id
WHERE p.period <> 5
GROUP BY t.team_name ORDER BY proportion DESC

WITH d AS (SELECT p.player_name, count(*) AS dribbles_reussis FROM sb.events e JOIN sb.players p USING (player_id) WHERE e.type='Dribble' AND e.details->'dribble'->'outcome'->>'name'='Complete' AND e.period<>5 GROUP BY p.player_name) SELECT * FROM d WHERE dribbles_reussis=(SELECT max(dribbles_reussis) FROM d)
SELECT avg(duration_seconds) AS duree_moyenne_secondes, count(*) AS nb_possessions FROM sb.possessions WHERE period <> 5

WITH xg AS (
  SELECT t.team_name, SUM(s.statsbomb_xg) AS xg_total, COUNT(*) AS tirs
  FROM sb.shots s
  JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id
  JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = e.team_id
  WHERE e.period <> 5
  GROUP BY t.team_name
)
SELECT team_name, xg_total, tirs FROM xg
WHERE xg_total = (SELECT MAX(xg_total) FROM xg)
SELECT t.team_name, count(*) AS fautes_commises FROM sb.events e JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id=e.team_id WHERE e.type='Foul Committed' AND t.team_name='Uruguay' AND e.period<>5 GROUP BY t.team_name

WITH m AS (SELECT m.match_id, m.match_date, m.stage, th.team_name home, ta.team_name away, m.home_score, m.away_score, m.home_score+m.away_score total FROM sb.matches m JOIN sb.teams th ON th.team_id=m.home_team_id JOIN sb.teams ta ON ta.team_id=m.away_team_id)
SELECT match_date, stage, home, away, home_score, away_score, total FROM m WHERE total=(SELECT max(total) FROM m)

SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pa.outcome IS NULL) AS passes_reussies, COUNT(*) AS passes_tentees FROM sb.events e JOIN sb.passes pa ON pa.event_id=e.event_id JOIN sb.players p ON p.player_id=e.player_id WHERE e.player_id=5463 AND e.period<>5 GROUP BY p.player_name

WITH b AS (
  SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(DISTINCT e.player_id) AS nb_buteurs
  FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id
  JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = e.team_id
  WHERE s.outcome = 'Goal' AND e.period <> 5
  GROUP BY t.team_name
)
SELECT team_name, nb_buteurs FROM b WHERE nb_buteurs = (SELECT MAX(nb_buteurs) FROM b)

FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id=s.event_id
WHERE s.shot_type='Penalty' AND e.period<>5

interpretation: part moyenne du temps de possession par match
sql:
WITH tm AS (
  SELECT m.match_id, t.team_id FROM sb.matches m CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (m.home_team_id),(m.away_team_id)) t(team_id)
), d AS (
  SELECT tm.team_id,
    SUM(p.duration_seconds) FILTER (WHERE p.team_id = tm.team_id) AS sec_team,
    SUM(p.duration_seconds) AS sec_total,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tm.match_id) AS matchs
  FROM tm JOIN sb.possessions p ON p.match_id = tm.match_id AND p.period <> 5
  GROUP BY tm.team_id
), r AS (
  SELECT t.team_name, d.matchs, d.sec_team AS secondes_possession, d.sec_total AS secondes_totales_matchs,
         d.sec_team::numeric / d.sec_total AS part_possession,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY d.sec_team::numeric / d.sec_total DESC) AS rang
  FROM d JOIN sb.teams t USING (team_id)
)
SELECT team_name, matchs, secondes_possession, secondes_totales_matchs, part_possession
FROM r WHERE rang = 1

SELECT m.stadium, m.match_date, th.team_name AS home, ta.team_name AS away, m.home_score, m.away_score FROM sb.matches m JOIN sb.teams th ON th.team_id=m.home_team_id JOIN sb.teams ta ON ta.team_id=m.away_team_id WHERE m.stage='Final'

SELECT count(*) AS tirs, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.outcome IN ('Goal','Saved')) AS cadres, 100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.outcome IN ('Goal','Saved'))/count(*) AS pct_cadres FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id=s.event_id JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id=e.team_id WHERE t.team_name='France' AND e.period<>5

SELECT t.team_name, count(*) AS passes_tentees, count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.outcome IS NULL) AS passes_reussies, count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.outcome IS NULL)::numeric / count(*) AS taux_reussite
FROM sb.passes p JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = p.event_id JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = e.team_id
WHERE t.team_name = 'Spain' AND e.period <> 5
GROUP BY t.team_name

SELECT t.team_name, count(*) AS tirs
FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = e.team_id
WHERE t.team_name = 'Croatia' AND e.period <> 5
GROUP BY t.team_name

SELECT COALESCE(t.team_name, 'Total') AS equipe, count(*) AS tirs
FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id
JOIN sb.matches m ON m.match_id = e.match_id
JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = e.team_id
WHERE m.stage = 'Final' AND e.period <> 5
GROUP BY ROLLUP(t.team_name) ORDER BY t.team_name NULLS LAST

WITH t AS (
  SELECT tm.team_name, count(*) AS tirs_hors_surface
  FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id
  JOIN sb.teams tm ON tm.team_id = e.team_id
  WHERE e.period <> 5
    AND NOT (e.loc_x >= 102 AND e.loc_y BETWEEN 18 AND 62)
  GROUP BY tm.team_name
)
SELECT team_name, tirs_hors_surface FROM t
WHERE tirs_hors_surface = (SELECT max(tirs_hors_surface) FROM t)

WITH so AS (
  SELECT e.match_id, e.team_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.outcome='Goal') AS buts
  FROM sb.events e JOIN sb.shots s ON s.event_id=e.event_id
  WHERE e.period=5 GROUP BY e.match_id, e.team_id
), w AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (match_id) match_id, team_id, buts FROM so ORDER BY match_id, buts DESC
)
SELECT t.team_name, count(*) AS seances_gagnees
FROM w JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id=w.team_id
GROUP BY t.team_name ORDER BY seances_gagnees DESC, t.team_name
